summary.text: Lisa Moser is a Republican state representative from Kansas who has represented District 106 since January 2021 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Lisa Moser earned a degree in animal science from Kansas State University in 1981, and her career experience includes working as a farmer and co-owning Moser Ranch.
Moser took office representing Kansas House District 106 on January 11, 2021, succeeding Bill Pannbacker.
In the 2025–2026 session she was assigned to the Agriculture Committee and the Appropriations Committee and chaired the Agriculture and Natural Resources Budget Committee.
